regions.region: page 1 title, abstract reaction graphic, and abstract text
regions.finding: General oxidative dimeric cyclization-coupling transformation only; the 64-75% span summarizes several scope experiments and is not an individual experimental run.
Background and cited prior literature; no experiment newly reported by this article is specified in this region.

unresolved: The abstract uses generic R1/R2 structures; complete molecule identities and stereochemistry cannot be assigned from this page alone.

regions.finding: Two conceptual general-scheme arrows (single-allene cyclization and biallene cyclization-dimerization), not experiment-specific reported runs.

regions.region: page 2 left-column equation 1 and surrounding prose
regions.finding: Prior work attributed to reference 12d; retained as a literature example rather than a new experiment in this paper.
Nine independent optimization experiments, separated by alkyl iodide amount/identity, solvent, temperature, time, and outcomes for products 3a and 4a; zero and trace results are retained.
X-ray/ORTEP characterization of the two relative isomers of product 3a; this supports product identity but is not a separate reaction experiment.

regions.region: page 2 prose below Table 1 and Scheme 2
regions.finding: Narrative repeats Table 1 outcomes and solvent trends; no additional independent experiment beyond the table rows.

unresolved: Table 1 does not state a yield measurement basis for entries other than entry 2's cross-page typical procedure.
The article's SI is mentioned but was not supplied or explicitly associated.

regions.region: page 3 upper Table 2, shared arrow, entries 1-6, and footnotes a-c
regions.finding: Six substrate-scope rows. Entry 1 is the same 1a/3a 74% experiment as Table 1 entry 2 and the typical procedure, so it is merged rather than duplicated; entries 2-6 are independent records. Footnote c's 21% cycloisomerization product is product-specific for entry 6.
Independent stoichiometric-PdCl2 control: 1a with 0.5 equiv PdCl2 in DMA at 80 °C for 2 h gave 3a (42%) and 4a (6%).
Two independent high-boiling-alkyl-iodide controls with distinct iodides, times, 3a yields, and iodide recoveries (94% and 95%).

regions.region: page 3 lower-right equation 5 and adjacent pure-O2 sentence
regions.finding: Argon control is a quantified independent experiment (3a 26%, 4a 12%). Pure-O2 bubbling is a separate qualitative observation reported only as much faster, with no exact time or yield.

Detailed quantities, workup, purification, isolated mass/yield, diastereomer ratio, separation, and melting points; merged into Table 1 entry 2/Table 2 entry 1 rather than made a duplicate experiment.
Crystallographic characterization of the two 3a relative isomers; no new reaction experiment.

regions.region: page 3 final mechanism sentence continuing to page 4
regions.finding: Beginning of the authors' proposed Pd(II)/Pd(0) mechanism, classified as mechanism rather than a reported experiment.

unresolved: Yield measurement bases are absent for most table/control outcomes.
Relative configurations for Table 2 products other than 3a are explicitly tentative.
The exact label/structure of Table 2 entry 6's 21% cycloisomerization product is not printed in footnote c.
The high-boiling iodide names/SMILES and all complex product SMILES are machine candidates requiring source review.
Pure-O2 bubbling lacks a complete reaction composition, exact time/rate, yield, and workup.

regions.finding: Proposed double cyclic oxypalladation/reductive-elimination sequence and O2/alkyl-iodide reoxidation of Pd(0); classified as mechanism, not an experiment.
Summary and funding statements; no additional reaction experiment.
The article says typical procedure and analytical data are available as SI, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated in this workspace.
Citations to prior bibutenolide syntheses only; no experiment details to extract as a record.

unresolved: No SI was supplied, so product analytical details outside the main text remain unavailable.
The proposed intermediates are described in prose but not isolated or kinetically quantified on this page.
